reasons: Cited Sections 22.1–22.3 support every preferred parameter: once per twelve-month period, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours without unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems and unrelated Customer Data.
Walk-away triggers (unlimited/unannounced audits, remote system access) are affirmatively excluded by 22.2; Section 22.3 adds further Customer-favourable protections.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the paragraphs are returned unchanged; deterministic check on audit frequency also passes.
